Maya Singh (CSM): Quick alert 1 AuroraTech prod tokens jumped ~180% starting Thu morning. QBR is Friday noon; we need a crisp one-slide summary + action asks. Who can own numbers and mitigations?
Omar Chen (FinOps): I can do the burn scenarios (baseline / current / curtailed). Need per-route split and prompt vs completion token counts. ETA 90m if pipeline isn't backfilled.
Leah Park (Onboarding): Any recent onboarding changes? We shipped a new example agent last week but it was flagged as beta. I'll check release notes.
Ravi Desai (Solutions Engineer): From quick signals: /v1/embed-batch and /v1/generate-long appear hot. If they're using embedders heavily in async jobs that could explain steady burn.
eng-usage-bot: Alert ua-99f1: customer=auroratech tokens +182% vs 30d baseline. Top models: redwood-embedding-2 (embeds=39% tokens), redwood-gen-32k (gen=48% tokens).
Maya Singh (CSM): Good to know. For QBR slide we should state: concise cause, three immediate mitigations, and the executive ask (credits smoothing or short-term reserved capacity).
Omar Chen (FinOps): Proposed mitigations to model in mitigated scenario:
- enable prefix KV cache for the agent template (est ~25% savings)
- temporary cap of 60 reqs/min on embed-batch route (unsafe burst control)
- model fallback for non-critical paths to redwood-gen-16k (lower per-token cost)
I'll run numbers for those combos.
Leah Park (Onboarding): I'll prepare a 20-min prompt tightening session we can offer this week and sample trimmed prompts (reduce context windows, use system prompts to limit generations).
Ravi Desai (Solutions Engineer): Also recommend turning on sampling on embed jobs (random 1% sampling for similarity index refreshes) while we investigate.
Maya Singh (CSM): Action list for slide prep:
- [ ] Omar: 3-scenario table + cost delta and suggested credits ask (ETA 90m)
- [ ] Eng: export top-200 prompt samples (prompt/completion token split) + per-route breakdown (ETA 90m)
- [ ] Leah: readiness workshop invite + trimmed prompt examples (ETA EOD)
- [ ] Ravi: mitigation wording + recommended throttle numbers (ETA 2h)
- [ ] Grace: note renewal-risk if no mitigation accepted (short blurb) (ETA 2h)
Grace Wu (Renewals): I'll draft a 2-sentence renewal-risk note and a suggested outreach sequence if spend remains elevated after mitigation.
Omar Chen (FinOps): Quick preview numbers (rough): weekly runrate pre-spike ~ $8.4k, current-runrate ~ $21.5k, mitigated (with KV+throttle+fallback) ~ $10.6k. I'll formalize with exact token deltas.
eng-usage-bot: Query q-aurora-1725 completed: top routes: /v1/embed-batch (41%), /v1/generate-long (37%), /v1/rerank (8%). Prompt vs completion tokens: prompt=34% , completion=66% for gen routes.
Maya Singh (CSM): Perfect. For the QBR deck language: short cause sentence, numbers row, three immediate asks (enable KV cache, accept temporary 60rpm cap on embed-batch, schedule 20-min prompt tightening). Can someone draft that exact phrasing?
Ravi Desai (Solutions Engineer): Draft verbiage: "We observed an operationally sustained increase in embedding and long-generation volume after AuroraTech's agent rollout. Recommended immediate actions: 1) enable prefix cache for agent templates, 2) apply a temporary 60 requests/min rate cap to embed-batch while we sample job types, and 3) switch non-critical generation to 16k model. These steps are projected to reduce token spend by ~50% within 48 hours."
Maya Singh (CSM): That reads well. I'll paste into the slide and tag Omar's numbers. Please react with :white_check_mark: when you own an item.
Leah Park (Onboarding): :white_check_mark: owning workshop logistics.
Omar Chen (FinOps): :white_check_mark: running final numbers now.
Ravi Desai (Solutions Engineer): :white_check_mark: drafting throttle config and rollout text.
eng-usage-bot: Ticket CS-9897 created for AuroraTech spend spike triage.
Maya Singh (CSM): Thanks team 1 I'll compile the slide and share an internal dry-run at 10am Fri before the QBR.
